# ChatGPT 引用与网站特征研究

- 作者：Alex Groberman（@alexgroberman）
- 发布时间：2026-10-13 23:49（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/alexgroberman/status/2110035111853109297
- 说明：中文全文翻译，后附英文原文。文中数据、观点及推广内容均为作者表述，未经独立验证。

---

## 中文全文

一项对 129,000 个网站、216,524 个页面和 100,000 条提示词的分析，找出了从 ChatGPT 获取流量的第一大秘诀。

它打破了许多迷思，也与我们对 AI 搜索系统如何检索、评估和重用信息的认识高度一致。

它也与 SEO Stuff 过去一年一直在打造的内容相吻合：

[https://seo-stuff.com/ai-seo](https://t.co/z7CwQrWps7)

下面我们来逐项分析。

先说最重要的发现：反向链接比其他任何因素都重要。

SE Ranking 的研究发现，拥有 32,000 个以上引荐域名的网站，被 ChatGPT 引用的可能性高出 3.5 倍。

域名信任度非常高的网站获得的引用数量，也几乎是低信任度域名的 4 倍。

如果你想了解自己的网站在 Google 和 AI 搜索中的表现，可以从这里开始。免费：

[https://seo-stuff.com](https://t.co/zvZUfkYWT4)

ChatGPT 可能会忽略一些老派 SEO 技巧，但权威性显然很重要。

高权威域名更有可能获得排名、被发现、进入 AI 检索流程，并最终被引用。

这就是为什么 SEO Stuff 的旗舰套餐包含 3 个与内容上下文相关、DR50+ 的反向链接：

[https://seo-stuff.com/gold-plan-package](https://t.co/MMsDTFf4rg)

主页流量是另一个重要信号。

主页访客达到 7,900 人以上的网站，被引用的可能性是其他网站的两倍；而每月访客达到 190,000 人以上的域名，获得的引用数几乎是较小网站的两倍。

这进一步说明了一件重要的事。

AI 搜索并不是独立于传统搜索可见度而存在的。

如果你的域名在更广泛的搜索生态中几乎没有存在感，那么它从一开始进入 AI 检索流程的机会就更少。

这就是为什么 SEO Stuff 的内容同时面向 Google 和大语言模型打造。

在 Quora 和 Reddit 上的存在感也很重要。

在 Quora 和 Reddit 上被大量提及的域名，被引用的可能性高出 4 倍。

即使是较小的品牌，参与相关讨论并被自然提及后，也看到了可衡量的提升。

这些提及可以强化外界对公司业务、所属类别以及是否有真人在讨论它的认知。

内容深度也很重要。

少于 800 词的文章平均获得 3.2 次引用，超过 2,900 词的文章平均获得 5.1 次引用，但单纯增加字数还不够。

更优质的内容包含多个角度、示例、专家引言、可核实的数据，以及更广泛的主题覆盖。

这也是 Premium Content Bundle 背后的思路：

[https://seo-stuff.com/premium-content-bundle-service](https://t.co/5osvnSaiGB)

该套餐包含 60 篇长篇文章，旨在围绕客户和 AI 系统正在研究的问题建立更深入的内容覆盖。

结构也带来了重大差异。

结构良好的页面获得的引用数高出 70%。

表现最好的页面使用清晰的标题、相对简洁的章节、符合逻辑的内容顺序、问题形式的 H2 标题和明确的答案。

大段密集文字和含糊的品牌故事，能让大语言模型可靠提取的信息要少得多。

内容的新鲜度也很重要。

在过去三个月内更新的页面，获得的引用数几乎翻倍：较旧页面平均获得 3.6 次引用，近期更新的内容平均获得 6.0 次。

更新并不自动意味着更好，但保持重要页面内容的时效性显然很重要。

问题形式的标题和常见问题解答也有帮助，特别是对较小的网站而言，在结合内容深度、权威性和良好结构时更是如此。

另一方面，LLMs.txt 几乎没有作用。

它的影响可以忽略不计。

权威性、结构和有用的内容重要得多。

评论平台是另一个强信号。

出现在 Trustpilot、Capterra、G2、Sitejabber 和 Yelp 上的品牌，获得的引用数是没有在这些平台上出现的品牌的 3 至 6 倍。

这再次提醒我们，AI 系统并不只通过你自己的网站来评估你的公司。

第三方声誉很重要。

核心网页指标（Core Web Vitals）也很重要。

加载快的页面被引用的频率是慢页面的 3 倍。

你不需要拿到完美分数，但确实需要避免网站慢得让人难以忍受或难以使用。

那么，真正推动 ChatGPT 可见度的是什么？

研究指出了以下因素：反向链接、域名信任度、主页权威性、Reddit 和 Quora 上的存在感、深度内容、清晰的结构、近期更新、评论平台可见度以及快速的网站性能。

换句话说，许多能帮助你在 Google 上获得表现的基础因素，也能帮助你在 AI 搜索中获得表现，同时还叠加了社交、结构和实体方面的信号。

这正是 SEO Stuff 的构建基础：

[https://seo-stuff.com](https://t.co/zvZUfkYWT4)

Done-For-You Gold Plan 将 10 篇针对 AI 搜索优化的长篇文章，与 3 个 DR50+ 的上下文相关反向链接结合在一起：

[https://seo-stuff.com/gold-plan-package](https://t.co/MMsDTFf4rg)

Premium Content Bundle 增加 60 篇深入文章，旨在扩大主题覆盖，并为搜索引擎和 AI 系统提供更多可供检索的有用信息：

[https://seo-stuff.com/premium-content-bundle-service](https://t.co/5osvnSaiGB)

Premium Backlink Bundle 则增加 3 个 DR50+ 的权威站点链接，旨在增强域名信任度和更广泛的品牌权威性：

[https://seo-stuff.com/premium-backlink-bundle-service](https://t.co/BMl9QCGGn3)

反向链接是整项研究中最强的因素。

但更广泛的结论是，AI 搜索可见度归结于权威性、清晰度、深度、结构、信任和内容新鲜度。

而 SEO Stuff 正是为提供这些而打造的。

## 英文原文

An analysis of 129,000 websites, 216,524 pages and 100,000 prompts determined the #1 secret to getting traffic from ChatGPT.

It busts a lot of myths and lines up closely with what we’ve learned about how AI search systems retrieve, evaluate and reuse information.

It also aligns with what SEO Stuff has been building over the past year:


https://
seo-stuff.com/ai-seo

Let’s break it down.

Headline first: backlinks mattered more than anything else.

The SE Ranking study found that sites with 32,000+ referring domains were 3.5x more likely to be cited by ChatGPT.

Sites with very high domain trust also earned nearly 4x more citations than low-trust domains.

If you want to see where your site stands across Google and AI search, start here. It’s free:


https://
seo-stuff.com

ChatGPT may ignore some old-school SEO tricks, but authority clearly matters.

High-authority domains are more likely to rank, get discovered, enter AI retrieval and ultimately get cited.

That is why SEO Stuff's flagship package includes three contextually relevant DR50+ backlinks:


https://
seo-stuff.com/gold-plan-pack
age
…

Homepage traffic was another major signal.

Sites with 7,900+ homepage visitors had twice the citation likelihood, while domains with 190,000+ monthly visitors earned nearly twice as many citations as smaller sites.

That reinforces something important.

AI search does not exist in isolation from traditional search visibility.

If your domain has almost no presence across the wider search ecosystem, it has fewer opportunities to enter AI retrieval in the first place.

This is why SEO Stuff content is built for Google and LLMs at the same time.

Presence on Quora and Reddit mattered too.

Domains with a lot of Quora and Reddit mentions had four times higher citation likelihood.

Even smaller brands saw measurable lifts from participating in relevant discussions and being referenced organically.

Those mentions can reinforce what the company does, which category it belongs to and whether real people are talking about it.

Content depth also mattered.

Articles under 800 words averaged 3.2 citations, while articles over 2,900 words averaged 5.1, but simply adding words is not enough.

The stronger content included multiple angles, examples, expert quotes, verifiable data and broader topic coverage.

That is the thinking behind the Premium Content Bundle:


https://
seo-stuff.com/premium-conten
t-bundle-service
…

It includes 60 long-form articles designed to build deeper coverage around the questions customers and AI systems are researching.

Structure made a major difference too.

Well-structured pages earned 70% more citations.

The strongest pages used clean headings, relatively concise sections, logical progression, question-based H2s and clear answers.

Walls of text and vague brand storytelling give LLMs much less they can reliably extract.

Freshness mattered as well.

Pages updated within the previous three months nearly doubled their citations, with older pages averaging 3.6 citations compared with 6.0 for recently updated content.

Newer does not automatically mean better, but keeping important pages current clearly matters.

Question-based titles and FAQs also helped, particularly for smaller sites, when combined with depth, authority and good structure.

LLMs.txt, on the other hand, did almost nothing.

Its impact was negligible.

Authority, structure and useful content mattered far more.

Review platforms were another strong signal.

Brands appearing on Trustpilot, Capterra, G2, Sitejabber and Yelp earned three to six times more citations than brands with no presence.

That is another reminder that AI systems do not evaluate your company only through your own website.

Third-party reputation matters.

Core Web Vitals mattered too.

Fast pages were cited three times more often than slow pages.

You do not need perfect scores, but you do need to avoid a site that is painfully slow or difficult to use.

So what actually drives ChatGPT visibility?

The study points to backlinks, domain trust, homepage authority, Reddit and Quora presence, deep content, clear structure, recent updates, review platform visibility and fast performance.

In other words, many of the fundamentals that help you in Google also help you in AI search, with additional social, structural and entity signals layered on top.
